evals.name: url-to-5-slides-board
evals.prompt: I need to present the key takeaways from this article about the future of AI in enterprise (https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-3-family) to our board of directors. Can you turn it into a 5-slide deck outline? Focus on the business value and competitive landscape.
evals.expected_output: A 5-slide deck outline following the template with HiTL references for each slide.

evals.name: vibe-coding-10-slides-marketing
evals.prompt: Here is a summary of the 'Vibe Coding' trend: Vibe coding is a software development approach where the focus is on the developer's intent and the 'feel' of the application, often powered by high-level AI instructions rather than manual syntax. It emphasizes rapid prototyping and aesthetic-first development. Turn this into a 10-slide deck outline for our marketing team to help them understand how we can position our tools for this new era.
evals.expected_output: A 10-slide deck outline using specific archetypes like 'The Pivot' or 'The Catalyst'.

evals.name: ssi-8-slides-investors
evals.prompt: We are building a new decentralized identity protocol. Based on the concept of 'Self-Sovereign Identity' (SSI), create an 8-slide pitch deck for venture capitalists. Focus on the problem of centralized data silos and how SSI solves it. Use a professional, high-stakes tone.
evals.expected_output: An 8-slide deck with HiTL references pointing to general SSI concepts.
